name: Shelly BLU TRV
summary: AA-battery Bluetooth/Zigbee thermostatic radiator valve head (M30x1.5) with display, boost and external-sensor support.

requires: Shelly BLU Gateway Gen3 (local) or Shelly Wi-Fi device as BLE gateway (fw ≥2.2.0, cloud)

extra.valve_thread: M30x1.5 native; adapters for Danfoss RA/RAV/RAVL, Caleffi, Giacomini, M28x1.5 etc.
extra.zigbee_reconnect: retries stop after ~8.5 days offline until reboot

gotchas: EU-model (SBTR-001AEU) radiator valve head — only for hydronic radiators with M30x1.5 or adapter-supported valves, not US forced-air/baseboard
No Wi-Fi: app control needs a Shelly BLE-gateway device (cloud) or BLU Gateway Gen3 for local control
If Zigbee coordinator is unreachable ~8.5 days, retries stop until you reboot the TRV
AA batteries ~2 years; failed OTA on weak batteries can drop it into bootloader (needs Android debug app)
Oventrop/Vaillant/Ista etc. need third-party adapters — check the valve compatibility PDF
best_for: room-by-room hydronic radiator control in a Shelly/Zigbee home
